LiveScoreboard.title: LiveScoreboard
LiveScoreboard.description: High-speed active cricket match broadcast document synced via Firestore onSnapshot to OBS/vMix overlays and multi-device scorers.

roomId.description: Isolated room / access identifier matching the document ID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified scorer owning this live scoreboard room.

activeMatchId.description: Identifier of the currently active cricket match.

matchStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the active match (archived is terminal).

legalBalls.description: Total legal deliveries bowled in the current innings.

extrasTotal.description: Total extras conceded in the current innings.

target.description: 2nd innings chase target runs (0 during 1st innings).

crr.description: Current run rate formatted to 2 decimal places.

rrr.description: Required run rate formatted to 2 decimal places (empty in 1st innings).

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter for conflict prevention.

lastActionId.description: Unique idempotency key for the last scoring or undo action.

deviceId.description: Client tab/device identifier that committed this revision.

matchState.description: Native Map containing the active CricketMatch state (innings, batters, bowlers, ball-by-ball events, overs, toss, result).

teams.description: Bounded native List of up to 4 Team maps needed to render the active match overlay.

overlayState.description: Native Map containing broadcast overlay display modes, ticker, and active transition banner.

tournamentSummary.description: Native Map containing non-PII active tournament title, format, and dates.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set strictly on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every atomic transaction.

LiveMatchSnapshot.title: LiveMatchSnapshot
LiveMatchSnapshot.description: Per-match real-time document under a scoreboard room for direct match-specific OBS/vMix overlay subscriptions.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-managed administrator role record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

TournamentUnlockCode.title: TournamentUnlockCode
TournamentUnlockCode.description: Permanent Firestore record for admin-generated Star Event Live tournament unlock codes (₹99/day) with server-validated expiry and atomic single-use redemption.

unlockCode.description: Unique uppercase tournament unlock code (e.g. TRN-3D-XXXX-XXXX).

durationDays.description: Unlocked tournament duration in days (1 to 365).

customerNote.description: Optional customer or tournament label entered by Admin.

lockedCustomerId.description: Optional customer ID this code is locked to (or null for any customer).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the unlock code.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp recorded strictly on creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp calculated from creation time plus durationDays.

redeemedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp recorded on customer redemption (or null).

redeemedBy.description: Customer ID or display label of the account that redeemed this code (or null).

redeemedByUid.description: Verified Firebase Auth UID of the customer who redeemed this code (or null).

tournamentId.description: Created tournament identifier bound once to this redeemed code (or null).

tournamentName.description: Created tournament display name bound to this redeemed code (or null).

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who generated or migrated this code.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on every write.

originalCreatedAt.description: Optional original creation timestamp preserved for migrated legacy Supabase records.

/liveScoreboards/{roomId}.description: Active cricket match real-time scoreboard state per room for instant OBS/vMix onSnapshot updates.

/liveScoreboards/{roomId}/matches/{match.description: Per-match real-time scoreboard state bound to its parent room via Master Gate.

/tournamentUnlockCodes/{codeId}.description: Permanent Firestore registry of admin-generated tournament unlock codes with server-enforced expiry and atomic redemption.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator lookup registry (read-only for verified self/admin; client writes denied).
